# Finage

Finage provides secure RESTful APIs for real-time and historical financial market data covering stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, and commodities.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/finage/.

## Actions

- **Get Stock End-of-Day Data** (read-only): This tool retrieves the end-of-day data for a specific stock symbol.
- **Get Stock Historical Data** (read-only): This tool will fetch historical daily stock data for a given stock symbol between specified dates.
- **Get Stock Last Quote** (read-only): This tool fetches the latest quote information for a specific stock symbol, providing real-time bid and ask prices, along with their…
- **Get Stock Market Aggregates** (read-only): This tool retrieves aggregated ohlcv (open, high, low, close, volume) data for stocks over specified time periods.
- **Get Stock Market Snapshot** (read-only): This tool provides a comprehensive snapshot of the us stock market data, allowing users to get the latest quotes and trades for multiple…
- **Get Stock Market Status** (read-only): This tool retrieves the current market status for various stock exchanges by determining if markets are open or closed.
- **Get Stock Previous Close Data** (read-only): This tool retrieves the previous day's closing data for a specific stock symbol.
- **Get Stock Market News** (read-only): This tool retrieves the latest market news from finage's api.
- **Get Stock Quote** (read-only): This tool retrieves real-time stock quote information for a given stock symbol.
- **Get Stock Tick Data** (read-only): The stock tick data api provides detailed tick-by-tick trading data for a specific stock symbol.
